provenance: PDF page numbers are one-based; lNNN lines follow pypdf extraction with extract_sources.py. PDFs remain only on the course-lectures branch.
precision: Decimal 80-digit finite binomial sums; exact Fraction enumeration for counts/data; binary64 erf, adaptive Simpson Student integration, half-integer gamma recurrence and 90-step bisection for quantiles. Not interval arithmetic.

lecture_coverage.L01: All evaluated counts, occupancy/geometric examples, numerical frequency illustrations. Generic combinatorial derivations and history are separately classified.
lecture_coverage.L02: Fair-die numeric result and five-option worked posterior; remaining arguments are symbolic.
lecture_coverage.L03: All evaluated examples, both normal reworkings, rough central band, typo approximation and coin size.
lecture_coverage.L04: Duplicate geometric worked examples audited with their own page anchors.
lecture_coverage.L05: No fixed-parameter evaluated numeric example; six parameterized distribution/CDF examples. Jump convention audited.
lecture_coverage.L06: All evaluated tables and numeric conclusions; convolution polynomial families have independent rational grid diagnostics; other parameterized transforms classified separately.
lecture_coverage.L07: Three-sigma comparisons audited; Cauchy and LLN examples are symbolic/no numerical answer.
lecture_coverage.L08: No finite fixed-parameter numerical worked answer. Bernoulli/Uniform CLT examples symbolic; Poisson limit explicitly distinguished from finite probability.
lecture_coverage.L09: All eight evaluated Chebyshev / normal-binomial worked examples.
lecture_coverage.L10: LP/rain examples, numerical CDF and Pearson tables; invalid/incomplete data explicitly prevent a valid GOF decision.
lecture_coverage.L11: All sample/interval/coin examples plus tail illustration; data-derived and separately given-summary intervals both recorded.
lecture_coverage.L12: Only worked numerical test is the proportion test; a=3 and lambda=2 are hypothesis-definition examples without calculated answers.
